_comment: Default configuration for UnifiedBDDLinter, with every value at its
built-in default. Copy to your project root as '.unified-lintrc.json'
and edit. The linter walks upward from the target looking for that name,
so one file at a repository root governs every subdirectory.
Every value below is what the engine uses when no config is present, so
copying this file unchanged does not alter behaviour. Keys are optional:
omit anything you are not changing. Unknown keys are ignored, and a
malformed file WARNS and falls back to defaults rather than stopping the
linter. Run 'bddlint config' to see what actually resolved.
Note: JSON has no comment syntax, hence this array. It is ignored.
